Native participant and trial functional random-effect plots

etr_native_mixed_random_effects_plots.Rd

Read-only base R plotting of the realized participant-level functional random intercepts or slopes and nested-trial functional random intercepts. The native plots expose ordered numerical line data for source qualification and do not fit a mixed model, bootstrap observations or select a scientific threshold.

Plotting parameters

result

Explicit realized mixed-model source-compatible native record including random-effect arrays, names, time and time unit.

effect

Participant random functional effect: intercept or slope.

max_participants

Positive integer participant limit, or NULL.

alpha

Line opacity within (0, 1].

participant_id

Optional named source participant; NULL for all.

max_trials

Positive integer number of unique retained trial IDs.

Details

The published scientific source is eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0, commit c1cd95ad718327550f7e55393ff38582872f7a94, plotting.py and functional_mixed_effects_nested.py. Matplotlib Axes returns and Python frozen result dataclass type constraints are not equivalent to native R base graphics and named-list inputs; these are explicit unresolved source-contract differences.

Value

An invisible R list with numeric source-ordered plotting lines, selected source identities and conservative backend provenance.
